Command: Wash hands and feet at the bronze laver before service
Summary: The command: Wash hands and feet at the bronze laver before service (Exodus 30:19). Aaron and his sons washed at the laver before approaching the altar or entering the tent, on pain of death.
Commandment: Wash hands and feet at the bronze laver before service, as prescribed in Exodus 30:19.
Application: This row narrows the parent group command to this one mitzvah. The moral/ceremonial/civil division is a traditional classification, not Scripture's own division; this law is traditionally classed as ceremonial. Hebrews teaches the earthly tabernacle was a copy of the heavenly one, and Christ now serves as high priest in the true tabernacle.
Purpose: To give Israel a mediated approach to God through the tabernacle pattern (Exodus 25:40). Hebrews teaches the earthly copy gave way to Christ's priesthood in the true tabernacle (Hebrews 8:1-6).
